# native-ce legacy direct-tool inventory

This inventory covers only the legacy transport that advertises each registered operation as a direct tool. It does not describe the contract-derived executor catalogue.

**93 tools** are registered in the legacy complete surface; 79 have a text renderer. The legacy default complete profile advertises all of them. Focused and custom filtering are intentionally lossy: hidden tools can be undiscoverable and visible workflows can lose dependencies. Filtering does not change exact-name dispatch or authorization.

- **focused**: 27 tools, 70614 compact UTF-8 bytes
- **complete**: 93 tools, 228254 compact UTF-8 bytes

Totals are the exact compact JSON `result.tools` arrays. Per-tool bytes below are descriptor deltas before array commas/brackets.
